Name: Pau's Rose Gold Weapons
Author: suzukiPC
Description:
[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/how-to-install2.png[/img]

1) Install [url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url], [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1915]Content Patcher[/url], and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url]
2) Download the file and unzip it; extract it into your Mods folder

[img]https://file.garden/ZgeIGUDRARPwyXAZ/Nexus%20Scrolls/features.png[/img]

﻿1) Retextures a few sets of weapons and then some;
﻿✨ Galaxy Set
﻿✨ Infinity Set
﻿✨ Dragontooth Set
﻿✨ Iridium Needle
﻿✨ Master Slingshot

2) Toggleable skins located in [b]Generic Mod Config[/b] Menu :)
﻿✨ Whole sets can be turned on and off for when you prefer base game or a different mod
﻿✨ The sparkles for Rose Gold can be turned off and on (Default on)
